top_signals.title: IAG Raises Fuel Bill Forecast as Iran War Hikes Oil Prices
top_signals.summary: IAG SA raised its fuel bill prediction for this year and said prices would remain high into 2027, joining other European airlines with a downcast prediction as the Iran war continues to drive up oil costs.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Oil Declines on Signs of Moves Toward Gulf War De-Escalation
top_signals.summary: Oil erased an earlier advance as traders weighed reports of US engagement in efforts to step up negotiations in the Middle East.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Angola’s Central Bank Expects Single-Digit Inflation to Last
top_signals.summary: Angola’s central bank expects to keep inflation under control after bringing it down to single digits, avoiding a repeat of previous episodes when prices surged again.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: European Stocks Join Global Selloff as AI Concerns Spread
top_signals.summary: European shares joined a global selloff, wiping out their weekly gain as concerns over the Democratic sweep of Congress and its implications for the artificial intelligence trade triggered losses across every sector.
